dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge spline with a deep notch-like curvature midpoint to the base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a sharp, minimal-pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex incline approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1.1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex arc with a large radius fitted to the dorsal-anterior forehead boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with thickness approximately 1.2x its visible length from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle where the descending melon slope meets the rostrum baseline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small white notches/nicks on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; scattered dark circular pigmentation spots on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Tail fluke with a deep, V-shaped median notch and acute tips; high-contrast specular highlights on the mid-body due to lighting conditions.
